root: ^"Welcome back, Peggy and Rocky. Is there anything you want to start off with?"
^"I think it went well. I had fun."
^"Rocky made it to the top. It was nice to do something together."
^"I'm glad you guys are making an effort to reconnect!"
^"It seems like this will be a fun hobby for you two to invest in and will help you understand each other."
^"But ultimately, the question remains: do you think you can keep building this relationship, or do you feel it might be time to go your separate ways?"
